description: Statically derived by structured reading of app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl, app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy, app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY and the shipped ASCII fixture, and NEVER captured from, recorded against or replayed from any execution of the legacy COBOL: executing these programs is empirically impossible in this environment - there is no z/OS and no CICS emulator, the available compiler reports its indexed file handler disabled and refuses a PROCEDURE ... USING program under -x, no Language Environment CEE* services exist, app/cpy/CUSTREC.cpy carries literal TAB characters that break parsing, and DFHAID, DFHBMSCA and DFHATTR are absent from the repository. That substitutes the PROVENANCE of the expected values and nothing else (AAP 0.7.6, practice B12, risk R-A, where the substitution is escalated for explicit user confirmation rather than silently absorbed). Every byte below is read out of three places and no fourth: the assembly at app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:1461-1475, the field offsets of app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy, and row index 0 of src/test/resources/fixtures/carddata.txt. Nothing here is a measurement of a run, and it must never be described as one - the claim would be most damaging in this case precisely because this is the ONLY case in the folder that asserts a MUTATION. THIS IS THE FOLDER'S ONLY SUCCESSFUL CARDDAT WRITE, and its expectedWrites entry is the folder's evidence for gate G19 (the 150-byte record width), gate G21 (FILLER present and space-filled) and requirement I1 (the copybook's own misspelling preserved). It is the second step of the two-step confirm flow: case15.json ends with the screen prompting 'Changes validated.Press F5 to save' and a commarea in state 'N', and this case is the F5 that saves. THE UNIT IS THE SERVICE, NOT THE CONTROLLER. unitKind is SERVICE: card.CardUpdateService is constructed through its own constructor over a fixture-backed card.CardRepository - readForUpdateByCardNumber for the READ ... UPDATE at :1427-1436 and rewrite for the REWRITE at :1477-1483 - and writeProcessing is called as a plain method on a plain object. There is NO MockMvc, no servlet container, no HTTP layer and no JobLauncher anywhere in the path (gate G51), which is what lets the byte layout and the concurrency check be asserted without a framework between the assertion and the code. BATCH_JOB and COMPONENT are both illegal for this program and neither is used. A DIRECT CONSEQUENCE WORTH STATING SO IT IS NOT READ AS AN OMISSION: because the unit is the service, this case's fingerprint is the written record, the outcome state and the return message, and it does NOT assemble the seventeen-field COCRDUP screen. expectedResponse is therefore null and no xxxO, xxxA or xxxL item appears anywhere below. The screen consequences of a successful save belong to the controller-level cases, and the reason is a real class boundary rather than a convenience: the literal 'Changes committed to database' that 3250-SETUP-INFOMSG selects at :1151-1152, from the 88 CONFIRM-UPDATE-SUCCESS at :168-169 and padded to the INFOMSGI X(40) width, is declared in CardUpdateController and not in CardUpdateService, so asserting it here would attribute to the service a decision the service does not make. On that same screen ERRMSGO would be 80 spaces. THE SEED. Row index 0 of fixtures/carddata.txt, which is byte-identical to row 0 of app/data/ASCII/carddata.txt and is composed here from the CVACT02Y spans rather than pasted, so every offset is checkable against the copybook (practice B11): CARD-NUM X(16) 0500024453765740 at [1-16], CARD-ACCT-ID 9(11) 00000000050 at [17-27], CARD-CVV-CD 9(03) 747 at [28-30], CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME X(50) 'Aniya Von' padded to fifty at [31-80], CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE X(10) 2023-03-09 at [81-90], CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS X(01) Y at [91] and FILLER X(59) at [92-150]. 16 + 11 + 3 + 50 + 10 + 1 + 59 = 150, and that sum is the self-check: a FILLER dropped or shortened makes the total wrong immediately (gates G19 and G21). CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE IS MISSPELLED IN app/cpy/CVACT02Y.cpy:9 and is reproduced verbatim as a field name in every map below (requirement I1); repairing the spelling would leave the differ looking for a field the decoder never produces, which is a silent parity break rather than a loud one. The fixture is in ascending CARD-NUM order, which is CARDDAT primary-key order, so the fixture line index IS the expectedFinalState row index. Rows 1 and 2 - Ward Jones on 0683586198171516 and Enrico Rosenbaum on 0923877193247330 - are seeded too and are asserted UNCHANGED, which is how this case proves the rewrite touched one row and not three. NO NORMALISATION IS DECLARED, and that is a measurement: carddata.txt rows are already the full 150 bytes with a space-filled FILLER, and the two markers ParityCase defines belong to cardxref, whose rows are 36 bytes against a 50-byte copybook, and to USRSEC. THE INBOUND PAYLOAD, AND ALL OF IT IS PAYLOAD (gate G37). No conversation state is held server-side. EIBCALEN is 160 + 329 = 489: the shared CARDDEMO-COMMAREA of app/cpy/COCOM01Y.cpy, whose sixteen items sum to 160, followed by WS-THIS-PROGCOMMAREA at app/cbl/COCRDUPC.cbl:274-321, which is CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION X(1) plus CCUP-OLD-DETAILS 89 plus CCUP-NEW-DETAILS 89 plus CARD-UPDATE-RECORD 150. The extension is carried as one 329-byte image because that is exactly how :396-400 slices what came back. CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION is 'N', the 88 CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED at :286. THE CCUP-OLD-DETAILS SNAPSHOT is exactly what case06.json derives - CCUP-OLD-ACCTID 00000000050, CCUP-OLD-CARDID 0500024453765740, CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD 747, CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME 'ANIYA VON' padded to X(50) and ALREADY UPPER-CASED by the INSPECT ... CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER at :1356-1358, CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR 2023, CCUP-OLD-EXPMON 03 and CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY 09 from the (1:4), (6:2) and (9:2) slices at :1361-1366, and CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD Y. CCUP-NEW-DETAILS carries the user's edits, and every chosen value is stated here rather than left to be inferred: CCUP-NEW-ACCTID 00000000050, CCUP-NEW-CARDID 0500024453765740, CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME 'MARIA DEL CARMEN VON' padded to X(50), CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR 2027, CCUP-NEW-EXPMON 11, CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY 09 and CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD N. CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD IS THREE SPACES, and it cannot be anything else: verified by exhaustive search, the item is declared at :306 and appears exactly once more, at :1464, as a SENDING item - it is assigned nowhere in the program, the COCRDUP map has no CVV field at all, and INITIALIZE CCUP-NEW-DETAILS at :586 is the last thing to touch it. Populating it 'helpfully' would erase the very defect this case exists to pin (practice B5). The CARD-UPDATE-RECORD span still holds nothing but its INITIALIZE residue - SPACES in the PIC X items, ZEROS in CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) and CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD PIC 9(03) - because it is written nowhere but 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING. The seven writable xxxI items are carried as mapFields at the widths app/cpy-bms/COCRDUP.CPY declares, because 1100-RECEIVE-MAP re-reads them on this pass and they must agree with the extension's CCUP-NEW-* values byte for byte. PF5 IS PRESSED: aid DFHPF5, which CVCRD01Y renders as the 88 CCARD-AID-PFK05 VALUE 'PFK05'. The case is SELF-CONTAINED (practice B9) - it declares its own complete pre-state and does not depend on case15.json having run first. THE AID SURVIVES COERCION, :413-424, AND ONLY BECAUSE OF THE STATE. SET PFK-INVALID TO TRUE runs unconditionally first. The validity test then admits CCARD-AID-ENTER OR CCARD-AID-PFK03 OR (CCARD-AID-PFK05 AND CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED) OR (CCARD-AID-PFK12 AND NOT CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED), and it is the THIRD limb that matches here: PF5 was pressed AND the state is 'N'. So PFK-VALID holds and the coercion IF PFK-INVALID SET CCARD-AID-ENTER TO TRUE at :422-424 DOES NOT FIRE. Had the state been anything other than 'N', PF5 would have been SILENTLY REWRITTEN TO ENTER and no save would have happened - that coupling is what makes this a two-step confirm flow rather than a one-key save, and it is why case15.json could not have saved even if the user had pressed F5 there. DISPATCH. The ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :429 passes arm one at :435 (it needs PFK03), the two compound limbs at :436-439 (they need CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE or CCUP-CHANGES-FAILED, that is 'C', 'L' or 'F', and the state is 'N'), arm two at :482-485 (CDEMO-PGM-ENTER or PFK12), arm three at :502-505 (CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED, or a CDEMO-FROM-PROGRAM of COMEN01C where this one is COCRDLIC) and the :517-518 pair, and reaches WHEN OTHER at :535, which performs 1000-PROCESS-INPUTS, then 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, then 3000-SEND-MAP. 1100-RECEIVE-MAP at :578-636 does INITIALIZE CCUP-NEW-DETAILS at :586 and then takes the ELSE limb of each guarded move, so CC-ACCT-ID and CCUP-NEW-ACCTID both take ACCTSIDI at :594 and CC-CARD-NUM and CCUP-NEW-CARDID both take CARDSIDI at :603 - THE ACCOUNT ID AND THE CARD NUMBER THIS PASS USES COME FROM THE SCREEN, which is what makes :1425 and :1463 read what they read. MOVE EXPDAYI TO CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY at :621 is UNCONDITIONAL, with no '*' or SPACES guard of its own, and is preserved as written (practice B5). 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS then does something easy to misread: CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED is false so :645-665 takes ELSE CONTINUE, and because CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED ALREADY HOLDS, the skip at :685-693 fires - all four of FLG-CARDNAME-ISVALID, FLG-CARDSTATUS-ISVALID, FLG-CARDEXPMON-ISVALID and FLG-CARDEXPYEAR-ISVALID are set and GO TO 1200-EDIT-MAP-INPUTS-EXIT is taken at :692, so 1230, 1240, 1250 and 1260 DO NOT RUN ON THE CONFIRM PASS and no edit can write a message. WS-RETURN-MSG therefore stays OFF at the SPACES :384 left in it, and that is what decides the inner EVALUATE below. The submitted values are all valid anyway - the name is letters and spaces only, which is what the INSPECT ... CONVERTING LIT-ALL-ALPHA-FROM TO LIT-ALL-SPACES-TO and the FUNCTION LENGTH(FUNCTION TRIM(CARD-NAME-CHECK)) = 0 test at :823-828 demand, the status 'N' satisfies 88 FLG-YES-NO-VALID VALUES 'Y', 'N' at :91, the month 11 satisfies 88 VALID-MONTH VALUES 1 THRU 12 at :95 and the year 2027 satisfies 88 VALID-YEAR VALUES 1950 THRU 2099 at :99 - and FOUR of them differ from the snapshot, so the FUNCTION UPPER-CASE comparison of the 59-byte CCUP-NEW-CARDDATA and CCUP-OLD-CARDDATA groups at :680-683 would not have matched either. That last point is not decoration: SET NO-CHANGES-DETECTED TO TRUE is a MOVE of a literal into WS-RETURN-MSG through the 88 at :187-188, so a no-change submission would have changed the very message this case asserts. 2000-DECIDE-ACTION, ARM (e), :988-1001 (gate G30). The ordered EVALUATE TRUE at :949 is walked arm by arm. (a) WHEN CCUP-DETAILS-NOT-FETCHED at :954 fails, the state being 'N' rather than LOW-VALUES or SPACES. (b) WHEN CCARD-AID-PFK12 at :958 fails, PF5 having been pressed, so the 9000-READ-DATA re-fetch at :961-965 does not run. (c) WHEN CCUP-SHOW-DETAILS at :971 fails, 'N' not being 'S'. (d) WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-NOT-OK at :982 fails, 'N' not being 'E'. (e) WHEN CCUP-CHANGES-OK-NOT-CONFIRMED AND CCARD-AID-PFK05 at :988-989 MATCHES - both operands are true - so PERFORM 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING THRU 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT runs at :990-991. THE BARE SECOND TEST OF THE SAME 88-LEVEL at :1006-1007 IS THEREFORE NEVER REACHED, and that arm belongs to case15.json, where the AID is ENTER and (e)'s extra AND fails. The contrast is the whole point: arm (e) and arm (f) test one condition twice and are told apart only by source order and by (e)'s conjunct, so a translation that deduplicated them, reordered them, or turned the EVALUATE into a dispatch on the state character would save unconfirmed changes on a plain ENTER. Arm (g) at :1011 and the WHEN OTHER abend at :1019-1026 are not reached. 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING, :1420-1493. MOVE CC-CARD-NUM TO WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM at :1425 sets the RIDFLD; the MOVE CC-ACCT-ID-N TO WS-CARD-RID-ACCT-ID on the line above at :1424 is COMMENTED OUT and stays that way (practice B5). EXEC CICS READ FILE(LIT-CARDFILENAME) UPDATE RIDFLD(WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) KEYLENGTH(LENGTH OF WS-CARD-RID-CARDNUM) INTO(CARD-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARD-RECORD) at :1427-1436 addresses file 'CARDDAT ' with a 16-BYTE KEY into a 150-BYTE record and takes the UPDATE lock; it maps onto CardRepository.readForUpdateByCardNumber and is driven to NORMAL (gate G47) BY THE SEEDED DATA ITSELF - forcedOutcomes is empty because a forced outcome exists to reach an arm no data can reach, and NORMAL is not such an arm. The lock check at :1441-1449 is IF WS-RESP-CD EQUAL TO DFHRESP(NORMAL) CONTINUE ELSE ..., and this pass takes the CONTINUE limb. NOTE THAT THE CHECK IS BINARY: NOTFND and every other RESP collapse into the single ELSE branch, which sets INPUT-ERROR, sets COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE only IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :1445, and leaves through GO TO 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT - that branch is case18.json's, not this one's. 9300-CHECK-CHANGE-IN-REC, :1498-1521 - THE OPTIMISTIC-CONCURRENCY CHECK, GATE G43, performed at :1453-1454. First, INSPECT CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME CONVERTING LIT-LOWER TO LIT-UPPER at :1499-1501, over the literals at :260-263, folds the FRESHLY RE-READ record's name IN PLACE: the stored 'Aniya Von' becomes 'ANIYA VON', which is precisely what makes it comparable with the already-folded snapshot. The fold is applied to the LEFT-HAND OPERAND ONLY - the record - and never to CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME. Then a SIX-FIELD AND-CHAIN at :1503-1508, and it is exactly six: CARD-CVV-CD equal to CCUP-OLD-CVV-CD, 747 to 747; CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME equal to CCUP-OLD-CRDNAME, 'ANIYA VON' padded to fifty against the same; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(1:4) equal to CCUP-OLD-EXPYEAR, 2023 to 2023; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(6:2) equal to CCUP-OLD-EXPMON, 03 to 03; CARD-EXPIRAION-DATE(9:2) equal to CCUP-OLD-EXPDAY, 09 to 09; and CARD-ACTIVE-STATUS equal to CCUP-OLD-CRDSTCD, Y to Y. CARD-NUM AND CARD-ACCT-ID ARE NOT COMPARED - six fields, no more, and a translation that added the key to the chain would be asserting something the COBOL never asks. The reference modifications are 1-BASED COBOL offsets into the ten-byte 'YYYY-MM-DD' string, re-derived by hand here: positions 1-4 are 2, 0, 2, 3; position 5 is the hyphen and is skipped; positions 6-7 are 0, 3; position 8 is the second hyphen and is skipped; positions 9-10 are 0, 9. THE COMPARISON IS AGAINST CCUP-OLD-*, WHICH IS WHAT THE SCREEN WAS PAINTED FROM, AND NEVER AGAINST CCUP-NEW-*. That is the entire meaning of the paragraph: a user's own edits can never trip it, only a concurrent third party's change can. All six operands match here, so :1509 takes CONTINUE, DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE is NOT set, and the IF DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE GO TO 9200-WRITE-PROCESSING-EXIT at :1455-1457 does not fire. GATE G44: THERE IS NO VERSION COLUMN, NO TIMESTAMP COLUMN, NO SEQUENCE COLUMN, NO DDL AND NO SCHEMA ARTEFACT OF ANY KIND anywhere in this case or in the code it drives. The check is a field-by-field comparison against a re-read record and nothing else, and introducing a version column to replace it would be a schema change the migration forbids outright. Only two programs in the whole migration carry this paragraph - this one and COACTUPC - so G43 is scoped to the card and account packages. THE 150-BYTE IMAGE, ASSEMBLED AT :1461-1475, ALL SEVEN FIELDS. (1) INITIALIZE CARD-UPDATE-RECORD at :1461. COBOL INITIALIZE DOES NOT TOUCH FILLER ITEMS, so the FILLER X(59) declared at :321 is not set by that statement; and CARD-UPDATE-RECORD at :314-321 is a SEPARATE STRUCTURE from the re-read CARD-RECORD, so nothing is copied through from the stored row either. Gate G21 nevertheless requires the FILLER to be present and space-filled in the serialized record, the fixture's own FILLER is 59 spaces, and the expected image accordingly carries 59 spaces at [92-150]. FILLER is declared as a field in the map below rather than left implicit, because the total width is the self-check that fails the instant it is omitted. (2) MOVE CCUP-NEW-CARDID TO CARD-UPDATE-NUM at :1462, X(16) to X(16): 0500024453765740. (3) MOVE CC-ACCT-ID-N TO CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID at :1463, from the NUMERIC REDEFINES view CC-ACCT-ID-N PIC 9(11) over the alphanumeric CC-ACCT-ID PIC X(11) in app/cpy/CVCRD01Y.cpy:34-36 into CARD-UPDATE-ACCT-ID PIC 9(11) (gate G34). The value written is WHATEVER THE SCREEN SUPPLIED, not what the re-read record held: 00000000050 here, which the two happen to agree on by construction, and the distinction is stated because it is the whole of what :1463 chooses. (4) THE HEADLINE DEFECT - THE CVV IS ZEROED. MOVE CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD TO CARD-CVV-CD-X at :1464 followed by MOVE CARD-CVV-CD-N TO CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD at :1465, over the CARD-CVV-CD-X PIC X(03) and CARD-CVV-CD-N REDEFINES CARD-CVV-CD-X PIC 9(03) pair at :107-109 - another gate G34 redefinition. CCUP-NEW-CVV-CD is SPACES, assigned nowhere in the program, so three spaces land in the alphanumeric view and are read straight back out through the PIC 9(03) view, whose digit nibbles evaluate to zero, and CARD-UPDATE-CVV-CD becomes 000. EVERY SUCCESSFUL UPDATE THEREFORE SILENTLY REPLACES THE CARD'S REAL CVV, 747 IN THIS ROW, WITH 000. This is a genuine legacy defect, it is verified by exhaustive search rather than assumed, and practice B5 requires it be preserved exactly: 747 is NOT carried through, the CVV is NOT sourced from the re-read record, and nothing here 'fixes' it. If CARD-CVV-CD ever reads 747 in this file, the defect has been accidentally repaired and the case is wrong. (5) MOVE CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME TO CARD-UPDATE-EMBOSSED-NAME at :1466, X(50) to X(50), left-justified and space-padded to fifty: 'MARIA DEL CARMEN VON' followed by thirty spaces. The value stored is the user's CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME VERBATIM - the INSPECT at :1499-1501 folded CARD-EMBOSSED-NAME, the re-read record's copy, and never CCUP-NEW-CRDNAME - so a mixed-case submission would be stored in mixed case, and this one is already upper case as typed. (6) STRING CCUP-NEW-EXPYEAR '-' CCUP-NEW-EXPMON '-' CCUP-NEW-EXPDAY DELIMITED BY SIZE INTO CARD-UPDATE-EXPIRAION-DATE at :1467-1474: 4 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 = 10, producing '2027-11-09' exactly. This is the inverse of the (1:4), (6:2) and (9:2) slicing above - the payload carries the year, month and day unhyphenated in eight bytes and the record needs them hyphenated in X(10) - and the ten bytes are summed mechanically rather than eyeballed. (7) MOVE CCUP-NEW-CRDSTCD TO CARD-UPDATE-ACTIVE-STATUS at :1475, X(1): N. THE REWRITE. EXEC CICS REWRITE FILE(LIT-CARDFILENAME) FROM(CARD-UPDATE-RECORD) LENGTH(LENGTH OF CARD-UPDATE-RECORD) at :1477-1483 writes 150 bytes to file 'CARDDAT ', maps onto CardRepository.rewrite, and is driven to NORMAL (gate G47). The post-check at :1488-1492 - IF WS-RESP-CD EQUAL TO DFHRESP(NORMAL) CONTINUE ELSE SET LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED TO TRUE - takes the CONTINUE limb. Recorded for the folder: THAT SET IS NOT GUARDED BY IF WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF, unlike its counterpart at :1445, and the asymmetry is real rather than a transcription slip; case19.json exercises it. THE OUTCOME. Back in arm (e), the inner EVALUATE TRUE at :992-1001 is ordered and every arm of it tests an 88-level ON WS-RETURN-MSG, so which arm is taken depends on what text that field holds. It holds SPACES, from SET WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF TO TRUE at :384 and unchanged since: no edit paragraph ran, the lock was taken, the concurrency check passed and the rewrite succeeded. So WHEN COULD-NOT-LOCK-FOR-UPDATE fails, WHEN LOCKED-BUT-UPDATE-FAILED fails, WHEN DATA-WAS-CHANGED-BEFORE-UPDATE fails, and WHEN OTHER at :999-1000 MATCHES: SET CCUP-CHANGES-OKAYED-AND-DONE TO TRUE, so CCUP-CHANGE-ACTION becomes 'C', the 88 at :287 (gate G30). WHEN OTHER is the only outcome of the four with no message literal of its own, which is exactly why the field is still blank afterwards. MESSAGES. The service's one observable message is WS-RETURN-MSG PIC X(75) at :173, still OFF at seventy-five spaces per the 88 WS-RETURN-MSG-OFF at :174. It is asserted on the width-free DISPLAY_LINE channel because neither fixed-width channel is 75 - WS_MESSAGE_80 is eighty and SCREEN_ERRMSG_78 is seventy-eight - and stating it positively is the point: a blank return message is what distinguishes this pass from every failure arm of 9200, each of which carries its own literal. No COBOL DISPLAY is emitted on this path. NEGATIVE ASSERTIONS, each verified by exhaustive search rather than assumed. NO CARDAIX ACCESS: LIT-CARDFILENAME-ACCT-PATH PIC X(8) VALUE 'CARDAIX ' is declared at :253-254 and REFERENCED NOWHERE in the program, and both account-id MOVEs into the RIDFLD, at :1379 and :1424, are commented out - so gate G45 holds in its strongest form here, the alternate index being a finder method on the single CardRepository rather than a second table, and this program never invoking it at all. NO THANK-YOU AND NO INVALID-KEY TEXT: CSMSG01Y's CCDA-MSG-THANK-YOU and CCDA-MSG-INVALID-KEY have zero references in COCRDUPC. NO WRITE, NO ADD AND NO DELETE: the program's only file-changing verb is the single REWRITE at :1478, and CardRepository defines no add and no delete. NO ABEND: there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' anywhere in COCRDUPC, which is why expectedReturnCode is 0 and why gate G35 is inapplicable rather than merely unasserted. DETERMINISM. The clock is pinned to 2022-07-19T23:12:33, the same instant case01.json pins and the instant this source's own version footer carries (practice B7); the code page is named US-ASCII explicitly and is never the platform default (practice B8); every field value is given at its exact declared width with its exact trailing spaces, and the comparison is field by field rather than as one string, which is what gate G17 requires of FieldDiffer and what the field maps exist for; and both RESP outcomes are fixed properties of the seeded data rather than of timing. The writes channel carries EXACTLY ONE entry - the one record 9200 wrote, at write position 0 - pinned both as the seven named CVACT02Y fields and as the whole 150-byte image, so a FILLER written as zeroes rather than spaces cannot pass. The final-state channel carries the resulting three rows so that no row is left unaccounted for, row 0 being the rewritten image and rows 1 and 2 byte-for-byte as seeded, with expectedDatasets pinning one row at 150 bytes on the writes channel and three at 150 bytes on the final-state channel. Gates asserted: G15 as case 16 of 20; G18 by diffing to zero; G19 at the 150-byte width; G21 with FILLER present and space-filled; G30 three times over - arm (e) taken where the bare arm (f) is not, the walked outer EVALUATE, and the inner EVALUATE reaching WHEN OTHER; G34 on both the CC-ACCT-ID / CC-ACCT-ID-N and CARD-CVV-CD-X / CARD-CVV-CD-N redefinition pairs; G37 with the whole conversation state in the payload; G43 as the six-field re-read comparison; G44 with no version column and no DDL; G45 as the negative CARDAIX assertion; G47 on the NORMAL outcomes of both the read-for-update and the rewrite; G51 by driving the service with no HTTP in the path; and requirement I1 through the misspelled field name. G32, G35 and G39 are deliberately NOT encoded: all 21 GO TO statements in this program are forward, there is no CALL 'CEE3ABD' at all, and this screen has no pagination. RULES. review_rules returns exactly one line, 'No user rules provided.', so NO user-specified rule governs this fixture and none has been invented; their absence is not treated as licence to lower the bar. It is held instead to enterprise best practice as the AAP records it - B1 real fixture data at verified coordinates, B3 with every reference input under app/cbl, app/cpy, app/cpy-bms, app/bms, app/csd and app/data read and not one byte written, B4 no silent scope creep, B5 the CVV defect and the two commented-out MOVEs preserved, B7 deterministic and non-interactive, B8 explicit widths, trailing spaces and code page, B9 self-contained, B11 hand-verified offsets summing to 150, and B12 with the provenance limitation documented and escalated rather than absorbed.
